item.name: Chakra Disrupting Needles
item.description: You throw specially prepared needles that drain your target's vitality and cause their attacks to recoil against them.
item.battleDescription: Before %target can react, tiny needles strike them, draining their vitality and turning their attacks back against them.

item.name: Lightning Crystal
item.description: A gem imbued with natural Lightning chakra. It increase Lightning damage done.

item.name: Flak Jacket
item.description: The common Chunin Flack Jacket. Stylish, Resourceful, and Symbolic. You have the swagger now.

item.name: Chakra Sword
item.description: A sword with special markings on it that seem to make the sword react when used in conjunction with chakra elements.
item.battleDescription: Channeling chakra into their sword %user sends chakra slashes that cut into %target

item.name: Elite Smoke Bomb
item.description: An upgraded version of the basic smoke bomb.
item.battleDescription: A blast of smoke covers the battlefield, obscuring everyone inside.

item.name: Panacea
item.description: A small pill radiating with energy. Its hard for any one person to metabolize the abundance of energy.
item.battleDescription: %user quickly crushes the small ball in their mouth releasing a burst of flavor and energy through their body. They seem to glow with vigor.
